verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job . . . replied
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO Jó respondeu, dizendo:

verses.original: ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י וְהַיָּתִי בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ־ יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: lū šā·qō·wl yiš·šā·qêl ka‘·śî wə·hay·yå̄·ṯī bə·mō·zə·na·yim yiś·’ū- yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: If only my grief could be weighed . . . and placed with my calamity on the scales
verses.literalPt: Oh! se a minha mágoa retamente se pesasse, e a minha miséria juntamente se pusesse numa balança!

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֗ה מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh mê·ḥō·wl yam·mîm yiḵ·bāḏ ‘al- kên də·ḇā·ray lā·‘ū
verses.literal: For then it would outweigh the sand of the seas no wonder . . . my words have been rash
verses.literalPt: Porque, na verdade, mais pesada seria, do que a areia dos mares; por isso é que as minhas palavras têm sido engolidas.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥiṣ·ṣê šad·day ‘im·mā·ḏî ’ă·šer ḥă·mā·ṯām šō·ṯāh rū·ḥî bi·‘ū·ṯê ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ya·‘ar·ḵū·nî
verses.literal: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me my spirit drinks in their poison the terrors of God are arrayed against me
verses.literalPt: Porque as flechas do Todo-Poderoso estão em mim, cujo ardente veneno suga o meu espírito; os terrores de Deus se armam contra mim.

verses.original: הֲיִֽנְהַק־ פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי־ דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה־ שּׁ֝֗וֹר עַל־ בְּלִילֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yin·haq- pe·re ‘ă·lê- ḏe·še ’im yiḡ·‘e·hō·šō- šôr ‘al- bə·lî·lōw
verses.literal: Does a wild donkey bray over fresh grass or an ox low over its fodder
verses.literalPt: Porventura zurrará o jumento montês junto à relva? Ou mugirá o boi junto ao seu pasto?

verses.original: הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִבְּלִי־ מֶ֑לַח אִם־ יֶשׁ־ טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yê·’ā·ḵêl tā·p̄êl mib·bə·lî- me·laḥ ’im- yeš- ṭa·‘am bə·rîr ḥal·lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Is tasteless food eaten without salt or is there flavor in the white of an egg
verses.literalPt: Ou comer-se-á sem sal o que é insípido? Ou haverá gosto na clara do ovo?

verses.original: מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגּ֣וֹעַ נַפְשִׁ֑י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’ă·nāh lin·gō·w·a‘ nap̄·šî hêm·māh kiḏ·wê laḥ·mî
verses.literal: My soul refuses to touch them they are loathsome food to me
verses.literalPt: A minha alma recusa tocá-las, pois são para mim como comida repugnante.

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên tā·ḇō·w še·’ĕ·lā·ṯî wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯî yit·tên ’ĕ·lō·w·ah
verses.literal: If only . . . my request were granted and God would fulfill my hope
verses.literalPt: Quem dera que se cumprisse o meu desejo, e que Deus me desse o que espero!

verses.original: וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗וֹ וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·’êl ’ĕ·lō·w·ah wî·ḏak·kə·’ê·nî yat·têr yā·ḏōw wî·ḇaṣ·ṣə·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: that God would be willing to crush me to unleash His hand and cut me off
verses.literalPt: E que Deus quisesse quebrantar-me, e soltasse a sua mão, e me acabasse!

verses.original: וּ֥תְהִי ע֨וֹד׀ נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל כִּי־ לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·hî ‘ō·wḏ ne·ḥā·mā·ṯî wa·’ă·sal·lə·ḏāh ḇə·ḥî·lāh lō yaḥ·mō·wl kî- lō ḵi·ḥaḏ·tî ’im·rê qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: It still brings me comfort and joy through unrelenting . . . pain that I have not denied the words of the Holy One
verses.literalPt: Isto ainda seria a minha consolação, e me refrigeraria no meu tormento, não me poupando ele; porque não ocultei as palavras do Santo.

verses.original: מַה־ כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי־ אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה־ קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי־ אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: mah- kō·ḥî ḵî- ’ă·ya·ḥêl ū·mah- qiṣ·ṣî kî- ’a·’ă·rîḵ nap̄·šî
verses.literal: What strength do I have that I should still hope What is my future that I should be patient
verses.literalPt: Qual é a minha força, para que eu espere? Ou qual é o meu fim, para que tenha ainda paciência?

verses.original: אִם־ כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑י אִֽם־ בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kō·aḥ ’ă·ḇā·nîm kō·ḥî ’im- bə·śā·rî nā·ḥūš
verses.literal: Is my strength like that of stone or my flesh made of bronze . . .
verses.literalPt: É porventura a minha força a força da pedra? Ou é de cobre a minha carne?

verses.original: הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’im ’ên ‘ez·rā·ṯî ḇî wə·ṯu·šî·yāh nid·də·ḥāh mim·men·nî
verses.literal: Is there any help within me now that success is driven from me
verses.literalPt: Está em mim a minha ajuda? Ou desamparou-me a verdadeira sabedoria?

verses.original: לַמָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·mās mê·rê·‘ê·hū ḥā·seḏ wə·yir·’aṯ šad·day ya·‘ă·zō·wḇ
verses.literal: A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Ao que está aflito devia o amigo mostrar compaixão, ainda ao que deixasse o temor do Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ־ נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥay bā·ḡə·ḏū ḵə·mōw- nā·ḥal ka·’ă·p̄îq nə·ḥā·lîm ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū
verses.literal: But my brothers are as faithless as wadis as seasonal streams . . . that overflow
verses.literalPt: Meus irmãos aleivosamente me trataram, como um ribeiro, como a torrente dos ribeiros que passam,

verses.original: הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי־ קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם־ שָֽׁלֶג׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qō·ḏə·rîm min·nî- qā·raḥ ‘ā·lê·mōw yiṯ·‘al·lem- šā·leḡ
verses.literal: darkened because of the ice and the inflow of melting snow
verses.literalPt: Que estão encobertos com a geada, e neles se esconde a neve,

verses.original: בְּ֭עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝חֻמּ֗וֹ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘êṯ yə·zō·rə·ḇū niṣ·mā·ṯū bə·ḥum·mōw niḏ·‘ă·ḵū mim·mə·qō·w·mām
verses.literal: but ceasing in the dry season . . . and vanishing from their channels in the heat
verses.literalPt: No tempo em que se derretem com o calor, se desfazem, e em se aquentando, desaparecem do seu lugar.

verses.original: יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אָרְח֣וֹת דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yil·lā·p̄ə·ṯū ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ dar·kām ya·‘ă·lū ḇat·tō·hū wə·yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: Caravans turn aside from their routes they go into the wasteland and perish
verses.literalPt: Desviam-se as veredas dos seus caminhos; sobem ao vácuo, e perecem.

verses.original: הִ֭בִּיטוּ אָרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hib·bî·ṭū ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ tê·mā hă·lî·ḵōṯ šə·b̲āʾ qiw·wū- lā·mōw
verses.literal: The caravans of Tema look for water the travelers of Sheba hope to find it
verses.literalPt: Os caminhantes de Tema os vêem; os passageiros de Sabá esperam por eles.

verses.original: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי־ בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·šū kî- ḇā·ṭāḥ bå̄·ʾū ‘ā·ḏe·hā way·yeḥ·pā·rū
verses.literal: They are confounded because they had hoped their arrival brings disappointment
verses.literalPt: Ficam envergonhados, por terem confiado e, chegando ali, se confundem.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לֹא תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh hĕ·yî·ṯem lō tir·’ū ḥă·ṯaṯ wat·tî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: For now you are of no help you see terror and you are afraid
verses.literalPt: Agora sois semelhantes a eles; vistes o terror, e temestes.

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽכִי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hăḵî- ’ā·mar·tî hā·ḇū lî ū·mik·kō·ḥă·ḵem ši·ḥă·ḏū ḇa·‘ă·ḏî
verses.literal: Have I ever said Give me something offer me a bribe . . . from your wealth
verses.literalPt: Acaso disse eu: Dai-me ou oferecei-me presentes de vossos bens?

verses.original: וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד־ צָ֑ר וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·lə·ṭū·nî mî·yaḏ- ṣār ū·mî·yaḏ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm tip̄·dū·nî
verses.literal: deliver me from the hand of the enemy redeem me from the grasp of the ruthless
verses.literalPt: Ou livrai-me das mãos do opressor? Ou redimi-me das mãos dos tiranos?

verses.original: ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּמַה־ שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·rū·nî wa·’ă·nî ’a·ḥă·rîš ū·ma·hō·šā- šā·g̲î·t̲î hā·ḇî·nū lî
verses.literal: Teach me and I will be silent Help me understand how I have erred
verses.literalPt: Ensinai-me, e eu me calarei; e fazei-me entender em que errei.

verses.original: מַה־ נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי־ יֹ֑שֶׁר וּמַה־ יּוֹכִ֖יחַ הוֹכֵ֣חַ מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mah- nim·rə·ṣū ’im·rê- yō·šer ū·mah- yō·w·ḵî·aḥ hō·w·ḵê·aḥ mik·kem
verses.literal: How painful are honest words But what does your argument . . . prove
verses.literalPt: Oh! quão fortes são as palavras da boa razão! Mas que é o que censura a vossa argüição?

verses.original: הַלְהוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hal·hō·w·ḵaḥ mil·lîm taḥ·šō·ḇū ū·lə·rū·aḥ ’im·rê nō·’āš
verses.literal: Do you intend to correct my words and treat as wind my cry of despair
verses.literalPt: Porventura buscareis palavras para me repreenderdes, visto que as razões do desesperado são como vento?

verses.original: אַף־ עַל־ יָת֥וֹם תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַל־ רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ‘al- yā·ṯō·wm tap·pî·lū wə·ṯiḵ·rū ‘al- rê·‘ă·ḵem
verses.literal: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away . . . . . . your friend
verses.literalPt: Mas antes lançais sortes sobre o órfão; e cavais uma cova para o amigo.

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ־ בִ֑י וְעַל־ פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם־ אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hō·w·’î·lū p̄ə·nū- ḇî wə·‘al- pə·nê·ḵem ’im- ’ă·ḵaz·zêḇ
verses.literal: But now please look at me Would I lie to your face . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, se sois servidos, olhai para mim; e vede se minto em vossa presença.

verses.original: שֻֽׁבוּ־ נָ֭א אַל־ תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וְשֻׁבִי ע֝וֹד צִדְקִי־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šu·ḇū- nā ’al- tə·hî ‘aw·lāh wə·šu·ḇī ‘ō·wḏ ṣiḏ·qî- ḇāh
verses.literal: Reconsider . . . do not be unjust Reconsider for my righteousness . . . is at stake
verses.literalPt: Voltai, pois, não haja iniqüidade; tornai-vos, digo, que ainda a minha justiça aparecerá nisso.

verses.original: הֲיֵשׁ־ בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֥י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם־ חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yêš- bil·šō·w·nî ‘aw·lāh ’im- ḥik·kî lō- yā·ḇîn haw·wō·wṯ
verses.literal: Is there iniquity on my tongue Can my mouth not discern malice
verses.literalPt: Há porventura iniqüidade na minha língua? Ou não poderia o meu paladar distinguir coisas iníquas?
